ja: • 劉備ガンダムの新装備バージョン。 ■真龍帝剣は「通常時」と覚醒した「戦等時」の二形態が付属。 ■青い刀「爪龍刀」は模様が新デザインにパワーアップ。 ■二本の刀は背中に装着可能。戦闘時の真龍帝剣も装着可能。 ■別売り「雷装　張飛ガンダム」「鬼牙装　関羽ガンダム」のパーツを使い三位一体を再現。 ■肩鎧のジョイント部分の変更により鎧の交換時にパーツをバラさず付け替え可能。　 成形品×4、シール×1、取説マンガ有り、超攻略G記（小冊子）
en: • New equipment version of Liu Bei Gundam. ■The Shinryutei sword comes with two forms: "normal" and the awakened "war". ■The blue sword "Claw Dragon Sword" has a new and more powerful pattern. ■Two swords can be attached to the back. The Shinryutei sword can also be attached during battle. ■Reproduce the Trinity using the parts of "Thunder Armor Zhang Fei Gundam" and "Kigasou Kanu Gundam" sold separately. ■By changing the joint part of the shoulder armor, you can replace the parts without taking them apart when replacing the armor. Molded product x 4, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included, super strategy G diary (booklet)
